correctness.rationale: The universal bound follows from a complete list of three primitive binary necklaces of length four and uniqueness of isolated affine fixed points. A periodic word of smaller symbolic period cannot support an isolated primitive period-four point because its affine fourth return would then have a nontrivial fixed affine subspace. At the rational parameter witness all sixteen symbolic words have nonzero det(I-M), exact strict roots, and no border roots. Exact monodromy traces, determinants, and Schur signs prove two saddle and one attracting period-four cycle. Strictness and invertibility prove open-parameter persistence. The standard-library exact checker reproduces all sixteen cases; its finite verification is not substituted for the universal argument.

value.rationale: The source explicitly emphasizes low-period attracting solutions as a complication of non-invertible bifurcation structure. A sharp maximum and a complete period-four census with simultaneous sink plus both saddle types supply a natural, parameter-robust finite invariant for that exact model. The three binary necklaces and exact rational witness expose coexistence structure not supplied by the previously known attracting LRRR region. The finding does not require a downstream global chaos theorem to have motivated finite classification value.
